encounter.reason: Lupus nephritis surveillance and proteinuria check

documents.title: Nephrology Clinic Note
documents.content: 35 yo female with known Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) and Class IV Lupus Nephritis. Currently maintained on Mycophenolate Mofetil and Hydroxychloroquine. Evaluated for increased peripheral edema and elevated blood pressure.

diagnostics.conclusion: Urine protein to creatinine ratio markedly elevated at 3.2 mg/mg (Ref: <0.2 mg/mg), demonstrating active nephrotic-range proteinuria and lupus flare.
